log.name: mint
log.result: I harvested mint from place 3. It goes in my pantry, and the plant grows back.

log.thought: Go outside to the pond to check the plants.

log.did: The pond was frozen all the way across. I slid over the ice on my feet, there and back, and fell once. I went home early, because I got very hungry.

log.thought: Let's check the notice board to see what people are asking for.

log.did: I read the notice board. New: someone wants a fruit bowl. On it now: a game about a jumping frog (5 coins), a fruit bowl (3 coins). If I make one of them, the coins are mine.

log.thought: I am hungry. Let me pick something.
log.name: basil
log.result: I harvested basil from place 2. It goes in my pantry, and the plant grows back.

thoughts.text: My mint is ready to harvest, and my legs want outside after eleven hours indoors.
